acceptance.given: Package A coverage and acceptance responsibilities are defined against the frozen requirements and existing workflow boundaries.

oracle.expected: The Package A contract or its migration-scope test explicitly preserves Q7/Q8 exact runtime case coverage and Acceptance ownership in the existing workflows, without assigning that ownership to Package A.
forbidden: Package A claims Q7/Q8 exact runtime case coverage or Acceptance ownership.
The Q7/Q8 ownership exclusion is absent.
oracle.observable: A targeted migration or scope-boundary test inspects the declared Package A ownership boundary and asserts the frozen Q7/Q8 exclusion.

acceptance.then: The ownership boundary remains explicit and verifiable, with Q7/Q8 coverage and Acceptance assigned to existing workflows.
acceptance.when: The targeted ownership-boundary test executes against the frozen Package A requirements and declared migration contract.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run an existing or source-authorized migration-scope pytest selector that raises AssertionError when the Q7/Q8 ownership exclusion is missing or Package A claims that ownership.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve and verify that Q7/Q8 exact runtime case coverage and Acceptance remain owned by existing workflows and are excluded from Package A.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the ownership-boundary handling without changing persisted state or schema compatibility.

slice_hint.state_transition: Existing workflows retain Q7/Q8 ownership before and after Package A validation; Package A gains no Q7/Q8 runtime ownership.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The migration-scope test passes only when the frozen Q7/Q8 ownership exclusion is present and Package A ownership is absent.
